    | timestamp = 00:16:08.331
    | text      = With their rotting sweat dripping on our faces.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:13.711
    | text      = And now, we have forced them off of us
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:17.951
    | text      = and metaphysically, culturally, spiritually-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:21.010
    | text      = Ecclesiastically.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:21.630
    | text      = ... with our hands
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:23.510
    | text      = firmly
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:24.811
    | text      = around their necks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:28.910
    | text      = And now,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:30.772
    | text      = with will and determination,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:33.850
    | text      = we squeeze and press those carotid arteries in
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:38.650
    | text      = and stop the blood from flowing and look into their eyes and say, "You want to destroy humanity?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:44.390
    | text      = You want to poison and kill our children? You want to destroy our destiny? No! No! No!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:54.890
    | text      = You will die!"
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:01.490
    | text      = All right, maybe we should turn the metronomy down so I can behave myself. (laughs)
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:06.351
    | text      = Whew.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:12.431
    | text      = Phew. Um,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:16.030
    | text      = I'd give Trump about a 97 right now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:17.911
    | text      = What is happening?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:18.951
    | text      = (laughs)
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:18.971
    | text      = But I would want, if you want 100% of my brain-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:20.832
    | text      = That's what you fucking got after that?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:23.111
    | text      = I'd give him about a 97.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:24.310
    | text      = What the fuck was that?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:26.092
    | text      = (laughs)
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:27.451
    | text      = Vi- violent murder fantasies, weird noise-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:30.770
    | text      = (laughs) What?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:31.351
    | text      = Yeah, Trump's getting 97%.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:33.411
    | text      = You know, I was, I, I, I-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:35.111
    | text      = Blah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:35.911
    | text      = At least somebody's happy, I guess. (laughs)
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:39.332
    | text      = I am amazed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:39.951
    | text      = Jesus Christ.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:41.852
    | text      = Oh my god.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:43.031
    | text      = So I thought it was a little early in the show for this. It was getting-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:46.730
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:46.971
    | text      = ... he was getting pretty deep into growly, uh, fantasies and, and shit a little early.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:52.011
    | text      = Sure, sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:52.611
    | text      = But it's just that adrenaline that you get when you see Trump give a boring speech at Davos. Uh, but
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:58.270
    | text      = thankfully, as the show goes on, the adrenaline wears off a little.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:01.611
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:02.330
    | text      = Now, the massive
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:05.911
    | text      = endorphin
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:07.830
    | text      = dump, the strongest I've ever had,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:11.230
    | text      = uh,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:12.250
    | text      = hopefully it's dissipated a lot, but it's, I'm, I'm still
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:15.490
    | text      = just
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:16.391
    | text      = cross-eyed right now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:20.050
    | text      = (exhales)
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:23.310
    | text      = Thank you, God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:25.871
    | text      = Because I just, you know, I mean, we're being destroyed by these people. I mean, they have killed
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:30.451
    | text      = so many of our people. They have, uh,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:31.990
    | text      = wounded and abused us. They have poisoned the daylights out of us. They have
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:36.070
    | text      = just done evils that are so unspeakable, right out in the open, normalizing it. And
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:40.530
    | text      = they were trying to break our will and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:42.211
    | text      = flip us into Stockholm syndrome, all of us, and just make us give up. And instead, to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:47.590
    | text      = see humanity rise, the sleeping giant awaken,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:51.691
    | text      = with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:52.990
    | text      = laser beams shooting out of its eyes,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:57.090
    | text      = is just beyond ecstasy and satisfaction.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:05.770
    | text      = And to really, really, really, really, really, really
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:10.530
    | text      = process that. (exhales)
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:14.790
    | text      = Oh, my heart, my guts, my brain, my bones, even my old
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:18.631
    | text      = injuries used to feel so good. Now it's pleasure coming out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:22.750
    | text      = What?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:23.931
    | text      = And my shattered arthritic hand, my leg, th- now it's pulsing with pleasure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:30.891
    | text      = I mean, this is a seismic spiritual flipping right now. It, it happened this morning, in the last hour.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:38.590
    | text      = I could feel it. They go, "Hey, you know,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:40.770
    | text      = he's about to speak." And I'm like, "Yeah, I knew that. It's gonna be great."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:43.351
    | text      = And, and then
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:44.270
    | text      = I was already like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:46.391
    | text      = trying to cover the news, trying to research, and I was just
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:48.351
    | text      = like pacing around going, "Ah, ah," because I felt a disturbance in the force.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:53.810
    | text      = A good one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:55.750
    | text      = The best.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:56.691
    | text      = Trump has made my pain pleasure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:58.931
    | text      = What is happening?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:00.931
    | text      = (laughs) It's pretty nuts.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:02.510
    | text      = I, okay, okay, okay. Maybe, maybe the, the idea of the God king who was born, uh, who was prophesied
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:12.431
    | text      = to take down these very people, going to them hat in hand being like, "Hey, buds, love you," is enough to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:18.330
    | text      = prompt an absolute psychotic break.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:20.611
    | text      = It could be. I also have another theory on this-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:23.050
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:23.351
    | text      = ... that will pay off in, like, probably our next episode.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:26.830
    | text      = (laughs)
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:28.111
    | text      = I'm, I'm withholding a little card-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:30.570
    | text      = Give me some of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:31.030
    | text      = ... but I don't know if I... Maybe I should just go ahead and tell you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:33.451
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:34.171
    | text      = He does have a bit of a welt on his forehead,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:36.971
    | text      = and he apparently, like, ran into a door-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:39.431
    | text      = (laughs)
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:39.451
    | text      = ... in the middle of the night.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:41.270
    | text      = So he might be concussed. (laughs) This might be-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:43.510
    | text      = (laughs)
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:44.510
    | text      = All, all of this might just be (laughs) -
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:47.250
    | text      = (laughs) He's, he's just physically incapable of doing his job right now. (laughs)
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:51.070
    | text      = He, he might actually have head trauma. (laughs)
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:55.391
    | text      = But, you know,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:56.530
    | text      = that, that, that was not even like, "Oh, this could be anything."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:00.911
    | text      = Mm-hmm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:01.730
    | text      = Head trauma should be specific.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:03.411
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:03.790
    | text      = Head trauma should be, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:05.411
    | text      = Uh, it was, it's, uh, yeah, there's,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:08.530
    | text      = on the next day's show at very least, there's a very noticeable welt on his-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:11.990
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:11.990
    | text      = ... uh, on his forehead.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:13.010
    | text      = If you have head trauma and nobody can tell if your behavior is different-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:17.471
    | text      = Mm-hmm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:17.851
    | text      = ... that's probably a sign you need something d- else to happen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:21.030
    | text      = When you've, when you have head trauma and people are like, "He's a little different."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:24.790
    | text      = Yeah. Yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:26.151
    | text      = "Maybe? Did you have an extra cup of coffee?"
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:27.611
    | text      = Maybe he's just, maybe he's just a little on it today.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:29.631
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:29.711
    | text      = That's not good. That's not good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:31.250
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:32.131
    | text      = So, uh, Alex has a guest on the show, and it is not someone who got pardoned, uh, for January 6th.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:37.711
    | text      = Mm-hmm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:38.030
    | text      = Uh, it is a Canadian fella who's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:40.550
    | text      = saw fit to hire Tommy Robinson and-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:42.951
    | text      = Great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:43.171
    | text      = ... Lauren Southern, just-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:44.010
    | text      = Good stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:44.471
    | text      = ... just great hiring decisions made-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:46.510
    | text      = Pillars of the community.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:47.330
    | text      = ... uh, by Ezra Levant.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:48.810
    | text      = Mm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:49.131
    | text      = So he comes in, because he went to Davos. And, uh,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:53.111
    | text      = (laughs)
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:54.330
    | text      = whew.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:54.371
    | text      = We asked him if he spoke to Donald Trump since the presidency.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:57.310
    | text      = Real quick, he put out a video of him bothering Larry Fink.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:00.830
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:00.891
    | text      = Uh, Larry Fink was walking around the streets.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:03.351
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:03.570
    | text      = And, uh, uh, Ezra Levant just followed him around, and, uh, Fink did not respond to anything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:09.790
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:10.111
    | text      = So he's, he's pretty proud of that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:11.290
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:11.590
    | text      = Uh, we asked him 70 questions. You know which one I forgot to ask him?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:16.510
    | text      = Was about his former,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:19.050
    | text      = uh, corporate video star. I don't know if you remember this, but
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:22.851
    | text      = the young man who
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:24.550
    | text      = shot President Trump in the ear, one inch away from murdering him,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:30.111
    | text      = bizarrely appeared in a BlackRock corporate video. And I forgot about that in the heat of the moment.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:35.391
    | text      = Uh, uh, I, I'd forgotten as well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:36.911
    | text      = B- because-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:37.131
    | text      = A- and I, and, and, and of course, also he famously says, "We're gonna use
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:40.990
    | text      = BlackRock's ESG control to control everybody's behavior."
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:44.790
    | text      = You're right, and Alex, how it works here is,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:47.790
    | text      = uh, we're not granted official accreditation to be in the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:51.030
    | text      = inner sanctum, so we're outside the security perimeter.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:55.431
    | text      = But every once in a while, a VVIP walks out of the security perimeter and mixes with us peasants.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:01.750
    | text      = So we're sort of on the street waiting for it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:04.131
    | text      = That's how we got Albert Bourla a couple of years ago. That's how, um,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:08.270
    | text      = Larry Fink came out. So, the trick is, you recognize someone, you say, "Is that Larry Fink?" And you only have
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:15.530
    | text      = a moment to jump into gear and try and come up with questions. That's why-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:19.371
    | text      = Oh, you guys, you guys, uh, l- l- let me tell you. You and your, your crew, Avi,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:23.471
    | text      = th- y- th- you guys are the best on your feet. I would not do that good, actually.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:27.270
    | text      = I mean, you guys just nail them and nail them and nail them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:30.550
    | text      = Oh, you, you're being too hard-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:30.730
    | text      = Oh my god.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:31.411
    | text      = You have such an encyclopedic knowledge of this stuff. And I'm not sure if you wanna play some of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:36.570
    | text      = Th- to me, the, the highlight or the lowlight of our
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:39.951
    | text      = walking scrum with Larry Fink, I mean, he really said nothing to us.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:43.871
    | text      = Um, we just asked him questions and his bodyguards sort of shoved us around.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:47.631
    | text      = But there was a moment where I can tell you-
